Expanded LLM context for the RustUse biology set.

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-biology/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-biology/llms-full.txt. The /sets/use-biology/ aliases serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
